Keywords: Morava crossings and the Styrian dispute
RagShortTexts: Ottokar and Béla IV contested rights around Austria and Styria.

Variants.Content: Ottokar and Béla IV contested rights around Austria and Styria, with Morava roads and crossings shaping concentration. Both needed noble support and provisions. In 1259 neither a decisive battle there nor its territorial result was an accomplished fact.
